exception_message: CUDA out of memory during native full-row read backward graph construction.
root_cause: Exact full-row native write-then-read training retains both long write and read autograd graphs; the attribution-only preflight did not cover narrative-length rows.
resolution: Offload native write/read saved tensors to pinned CPU memory while preserving world4, local batch4, microbatch2, accumulation2, global batch16, and exact full rows.
restart_policy: Discard the partial optimizer state and retry from the exact R12 warm start.
